title: Arborist - Just opened our playtest! If you love Slay the Spire, check it out!
author: SproutAndSesame
selftext:
I've played over 1,000 hours of Slay the Spire and Slay the Spire 2, and I kept wanting a deckbuilder that didn't have to be about fighting.

What I love most about the genre is finding the combo, when a few cards start working together and a run suddenly takes off. So I built Arborist around that. It's a cozy roguelike deckbuilder where you don't fight anything. You grow a garden and wait for the birds.

The playtest is open now, and I've spent the past 8 months polishing Arborist. Come check it out and join the Discord! I would greatly appreciate feedback from another dev if anyone has the time!

Steam: [https://store.steampowered.com/app/5250680/Arborist](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5250680/Arborist)

Discord: [https://discord.gg/6Kzskuf3T](https://discord.gg/6Kzskuf3T)

The trailer was made with Claude and the visual assets are all from ChatGPT!
